NIFTY 50 - V2 (TK cross + Chikou exit) - bias ON

Rules: 1h Ichimoku (9/26/52/26). Entry needs all four: (1) close beyond the cloud, (2) future cloud colour agrees, (3) Tenkan/Kijun side agrees, (4) Chikou (close plotted 26 bars back) beyond the cloud at that position. Stop = cloud edge at entry. V2 exits on a Tenkan/Kijun reverse cross or Chikou cross; no target. Execution on 1-minute data at the open after the signal bar closes.
Bias: previous day candle colour AND previous completed 4h session candle colour. Both green = longs only; both red = shorts only; otherwise no trade.
Costs: 0.05% round trip (0.010% slip + 0.015% charges per side). Sizing: $1,000 notional per trade; P&L = net % after costs x $1,000. Times shown in IST. Exploratory result, not a validated edge.
